title: Transient Darcian Lookup Candidate A/B/C
objective: Test whether an immutable oracle-derived Darcian face lookup improves transient LayeredMFP hydraulic trajectories relative to the current MFP-secant closure when both are compared with the admitted FullRichards reference on identical initial states, forcing, generic timestep grids and hard mass-conservation rules.
candidate_paths: oracle-derived immutable bilinear Darcian lookup face closure
qualification_questions: Does the Darcian lookup preserve the exact telescoping transient water balance without post-update clipping?
Does it improve the six existing F-LMFP04 trajectories against FullRichards without degrading steady uniform identity?
Does improvement persist when the reduced-order timestep is refined?
Do strong homogeneous vertical-gradient cases exposed by F-LMFP06 improve rather than merely move the error?
Can lookup coverage, interpolation class and fallback needs be diagnosed explicitly without adding committed per-column state?
planned_outputs: A/B/C trajectory evidence for six F-LMFP04 fixtures
qualification decision for process-expansion or further face-closure work
